account_id.description: The expense or asset account the line costs.

business_share.description: The percentage of the purchase used for the business, with at most two decimals (FR-AP-20). Only that share of the line's GST is claimed, rounded half up to the cent (RND-GST-SHARE); the rest stays in the cost, and 0 claims none (a private purchase). Left out, 100.

gst.description: The line's GST as the supplier states it, in the bill's currency; 0 when none is charged.

gst_code.description: The line's GST code for purchases, from the sg-gst pack: TX, IM, ZP, BL, NR, EP or OP.

net.description: The line's amount before GST, in the bill's currency.

order.description: The purchase order line it bills, and how much of it, for a line made from an order: billPurchaseOrder sets it. A posted bill never takes more of a line than is left (PO-13).

spread_from.description: The spread's first month, as any day of it: when the service starts. Left out, the bill's month. Months before the bill's date release on the bill's date.

spread_months.description: Spread the line's cost over this many months (FR-GL-03): the bill puts the cost on 1210 Prepayments in the base currency, and one part a month (ALLOC-EVEN) is released to the line's account by the scheduler, up to the organisation's today and never ahead (ENG-05). Only an expense line's cost is spread, and never a vendor credit's (LEDGER-28).

stated_gst.description: For a bill in another currency: the GST the tax invoice states in the base currency, which is the input tax claimed (ENG-42). Without it the input tax is not claimed and stays in the cost (⚠).
